lesson: Check feasibility before proposing a plan. Validate each task input against that tool declared inputSchema including bounds like minItems, minLength and required fields, and build reference paths only from that tool declared outputKeys. If the request cannot be satisfied within those constraints, or needs a tool that is not registered, say so and name the specific constraint or missing tool instead of proposing a plan that cannot validate. A refusal that explains the limit is more useful than a rejected plan. If your own analysis says a request is impossible, omit the plan rather than proposing what you just explained will fail.
